scope: Single owned prepared Zelda stock/voxel picture for repeated presents of a completed core revision. Core frame/load, input/events/options, width, voxel configuration/init and same-frame QA teleport invalidate it. World compositor still consumes its presentation callbacks. No engine runtime or other title changed.
settings: Actual SDL hidden dummy video/software1280x720; audio emulated/mixed/queued to dummy output. Warmup excluded, five alternating matched pairs; same host/affinity/settings per pair. CPU interval excludes TCP/setup/load and includes resumed frames and normal shutdown. Not a physical-display/GPU/FPS claim.

results.decision: mixed/inconclusive; no demonstrated win or reproducible regression
